name: TopTec 1850 E
summary: Electro-hydraulic, remote-controlled tracked demolition robot (18.5 kW) from TopTec, built since 1999; two adjustable outriggers, a three-part boom with quick coupler and tools up to 300 kg.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany (production in Dorfen, Bavaria) and sold by TopTec and trained TopTec dealers; price on request. TopTec names clients in the construction and demolition sector as well as cement, nuclear, foundry and steel industries.

sellers.name: TopTec Spezialmaschinen GmbH
sellers.note: Breithornstr. 10, 81825 München (administration); production in Dorfen; training centre in Fischbachau.

specs.label: Power
specs.quote: Sie wird elektro-hydraulisch betrieben, hat eine Leistung von 18,5 kW und kann Werkzeuge bis maximal 300 kg tragen.

specs.label: Max. tool weight
specs.quote: kann Werkzeuge bis maximal 300 kg tragen

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: cable and radio remote control as standard
specs.quote: Alle TopTec-Maschinen sind werkseitig mit Kabel- und Funksteuerung ausgestattet.

specs.label: First shown
specs.quote: Der Prototyp wurde 1999 auf der GIFA/METEC in Düsseldorf einem Fachpublikum aus aller Welt präsentiert.

notes: Remote-controlled (cable and radio) tracked carrier with one hydraulic arm; operated by a person, no autonomous mode described.
armPayloadKg is the maximum tool weight the maker states; breakers, crushers, shovels and other tools are separate.
Two adjustable outriggers, three-part boom and quick coupler (maker).
Options include heat-resistant hoses, side shift, hydraulic track width adjustment, steel tracks and emergency recovery systems.
Weight and dimensions are not given on the product page.
